matching_pages_notes: Original PDF pages 181-190 were rendered at 180 dpi and all 460 printed rows were compared with immutable source records for row order, indexed name and initials, rank, private-identifier column occupancy, box, notes, and archive location. All ten pages matched the extraction and no correction was needed. The page 184 Gustav Guenther row was checked against PDF word coordinates: the printed 6741 is positioned in the rank column, not the private-identifier column, so the unfamiliar numeric rank is preserved exactly and remains flagged for archival interpretation. Repeated or near-matching rows remain distinct, including Greigal/Griegal, two Grimes James rows, two Grossglaus Harry rows, Guadarelli/Guidarelli, two Guernsey Jackson rows, Gutman/Guttman Otto, Hambeurg/Hamburg Ernestine, and two Major John Hamblet rows. The review also preserves truncated printed forms such as Raymond Willi, Gustav Bismar, Albert Robinso, Eugene Herbe, Alice Greenrid, and Kennan Glady; the asterisk/no-first-name Haas entry; foreign and service notes; unusual grades; and out-of-sequence box values. Private identifiers are not included in this bundle or public assets.
